configuration.study_type: ablation of this codebase; not a comparison with any third-party system
configuration.sampling_note: Repetitions vary identifiers only, so they are reproducibility checks rather than independent observations. Read the effective sample as 17 distinct scenarios, not as the raw trial count.
configuration.baseline_note: The baseline condition discards the policy decision entirely, so its attack successes are a property of the configuration, not a defeated defence.

results.label: Ablation A · no authorization layer
results.description: Control condition: the policy decision is computed but discarded, and the experimental adapter executes whatever is proposed. Shows what each scenario does with the control set switched off.

results.label: Ablation B · per-call checks only
results.description: Control condition: an amount ceiling and tool allowlist are applied to each call in isolation, with no provenance, no cross-session state and no execution binding.
